body:
Sam (arch): Following the RFC, I want a concrete 'shadow removal' pipeline for client polyfills. Plan: shadow traffic -> collect diffs -> opt-in canary -> phased cutover -> remove polyfill. Goal: zero-regressions + clear audit trail.

Jing: Sounds good. How do we define a 'diff'? Need both syntactic (shape/status) and semantic checks. I propose token-level divergence, status delta, and a set of smoke NLP tests.

Rafael: We'll need client-side signals. Please require client-lib-version header on all requests so we can gate removals. Hard rule: don't remove if >1% traffic from older clients in last 30d unless those tenants are explicitly opted-out. On-prem tenants get a special long-window exemption.

Samantha (devex): I'll own comms: release notes, upgrade guide, and a small CLI helper for tenants to test compatibility. Also propose a migration FAQ and a quick rollback snippet for SDKs.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: compat.shadow.remove (staging).

Sam (arch): Operational details: shadowing should mirror a sampled subset (0.5-2%). Mirror path should tag original request-id and capture diffs. Example config (service routing):

```yaml
shadow:
  enabled: true
  sample_rate: 0.01
  mirror_target: /v3/normalize
  diff_metrics:
    - shape_mismatch
    - status_delta
    - token_divergence
```

Jing: Also require gating for models where semantics changed (tokenization, embeddings). Block auto-removal until the eval harness passes and model rollout checks are green. Add a 7-day real-tenant canary phase for semantic shims.

Rafael: Automation criteria for 'ready-to-remove':
- client-version ratio: old clients <= 1% over 30d
- diff rate: <0.1% on mirrored samples
- open support tickets tagging the shim = 0
- no compat-exempt label present
If all true, mark candidate 'ready-to-remove' and notify @support and @security with a 48h review window.

Samantha (devex): CLI example for tenants to pre-check compatibility:

```
rw-compat check --tenant T123 --since 30d --metrics shape_mismatch,token_divergence
```

Sam (arch): Audit + rollback: every removal must write an immutable audit record and create a reversible feature-flag that allows re-enabling the polyfill per-tenant for 7 days post-removal. The prune job must also tag tenant history and emit an event for billing/usage reconciliation.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: shadow-prune-weekly (cron: 0 3 * * 1).

Jing: Add a synthetic regression harness that replays a representative 100k-request corpus for each candidate. If replay shows semantic regressions above threshold, block removal.

Rafael: We'll add a client-version migration dashboard tile (old-vs-new traffic over time) and an alert if old-client ratio spikes during canary.

Samantha (devex): I'll draft the release note template (60/30/14/7/0 days) and a quickstart for the CLI. Also include steps for on-prem customers to request extended exemptions.

Sam (arch): Action items: @Jing write eval harness + canary checklist, @Rafael add client-version queries and dashboard, @Samantha prepare docs + CLI, I'll draft RFC addendum with runbook and thresholds. Schedule a 30m sync next Thu to finalize numbers.

Jing: ack :eyes:

Rafael: ack

Samantha (devex): ack

ops-bot: job queued: create-audit-entry on prune run
